description: This file defines a React functional component 'ChatInputPanel' for a chat application's input panel, handling user input, prompts, commands, image uploads, and interactions with chat state.

methods.name: scrollToBottom
methods.description: Scrolls the chat view to the bottom by updating the message render index and scrolling the DOM.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Handles user input in the textarea, managing prompt hints and commands.

methods.name: setMsgRenderIndex
methods.description: Sets the message render index within valid bounds, used for scrolling.

methods.name: doSubmit
methods.description: Handles submitting the user input, including command invocation and chat message handling.
